claims: The Artemis II Orion capsule is a 330-cubic-foot environment.
The Artemis II Orion capsule is roughly the size of two minivans.
Four astronauts will live, work, and sleep in the Artemis II Orion capsule for 10 days.
The Orion capsule has sleeping bags attached to the walls.
The crew uses wall-mounted sleeping bags for rest in the living quarters of the Orion capsule.
The Orion capsule has a specialized "zero-gravity" toilet concealed within a floor panel.
The cabin of the Orion capsule acts as both a cockpit and laboratory.
Astronauts will conduct experiments in the cabin of the Orion capsule.
Astronauts will fly the craft in microgravity in the cabin of the Orion capsule.
Astronauts will eat packaged, shelf-stable food.
Astronauts will use a water dispenser for hydration and rehydrating meals.
Astronauts will spend considerable time in their orange spacesuits, especially during launch, reentry, and for safety during the trip.
The crew will conduct a manual flying test by maneuvering the craft in microgravity.
